record.nameMeaning: "Pointed lizard", for the hornlets on its frill
record.oneLiner: A horned ceratopsian known from immense Alberta bonebeds.
record.description: Centrosaurus was a centrosaurine horned dinosaur from the Late Cretaceous of Alberta, Canada, with a single nasal horn and small hornlets along the margin of its frill. It is known from vast bonebeds containing thousands of individuals — possibly herds that drowned crossing flooded rivers.

notableFacts.text: Known from vast bonebeds with thousands of individuals — likely mass-drowned herds.
Named for the small hornlets along the margin of its frill.
